capabilities: Import assigned issues and opened/assigned PRs into a note as tasks
Import GitHub labels and repository names as tags
Mark closed issues and PRs as completed automatically
Refresh tasks on a configurable interval
Clear completed tasks from the note
extras: Sync is one-way: completing or editing tasks in Obsidian does not update GitHub, and edited tasks keep their local changes on refresh; the ^gh-####### tag must not be removed or tasks duplicate.
intentEvidence: Import tasks in Tasks Emoji format or Dataview format (see: Tasks documentation)
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull issues and pull requests from GitHub into task lists, so tracking assigned work means checking GitHub separately.
